kind: frozen decision-level policy replay, not native outcome evidence
goal: Understand Python memory growth and choose a diagnostic for allocation changes.

definitions.source_adequate: predeclared whether the excerpt contains evidence for the goal; not owner usefulness
definitions.feedback: scripted operator feedback only for the initial three negative observations and the probe case
definitions.repeated_work: analysis of an excerpt SHA already analysed by that arm
definitions.cost: 150 synthetic tokens per call at ALIVE price() estimate; not a provider charge

arms.A_frozen_context_wide: ALIVE-11 context-wide pause; support 3; pause at useful rate <= 0.20; every paused observation increments suppression, including repeated excerpts; next observation after 3 paused is a probe
arms.B_exact_negative_reuse: A negatively rated exact excerpt is remembered and suppressed; new excerpt SHA remains eligible; owner correction overrides; no context-wide pause
arms.C_evidence_aware_contextual: Support and pauses use distinct excerpt SHA; repeats, rated excerpts and probed excerpts do not increment; after 3 distinct paused excerpts only a fresh excerpt can probe; owner correction resets
arms.D_constant_analyse: Analyse every eligible observation; no feedback-conditioned pause

adoption_rule: Do not change the production policy from this decision replay alone. Require native qualification and independent review.
caveat: Predeclared labels are not owner ratings, model outputs, or native task outcomes. The replay must not be presented as evidence of semantic generalisation.
